blocking_findings.finding: Current v01 images do not follow their exact scripted staging. Current page 4 panel 4 is an iron-ring close-up instead of the ceiling impact with the mainmast balloon before and pump balloon after. Current page 4 panel 5 is an exterior ship and wave scene instead of the waist-deep hold with Keshavrao pointing to the ring. Current page 5 panel 1 is a standing Nagoji prison tableau instead of the close overhead ring with cracked wood. Current page 5 panel 2 is a seated two-person lock tableau instead of the ring tearing from its last bolt. Page 5 panel 3 v02 now fixes its earlier mismatch and is acceptable on staging. Regenerate or replace the four remaining frames before selection.

Current v01 compositions are close in mood but do not clearly carry all exact scripted beats. Page 6 panel 1 needs both men working along the beam, one chain dropping free, another ring holding, and the background prisoners staring after them. Page 6 panel 2 needs the ladder foot, thigh-deep water, submerged musket, Nagoji looking hatchward and Keshavrao looking toward Nagoji. Recheck against the exact script after any replacement.

The silhouette guard has visibly red sleeves and a dark vest. At native resolution the costume can read as a redcoat or generic modern military silhouette, conflicting with the Portuguese guard continuity. Recheck or regenerate with the Chapter 3 Portuguese guard look, soaked buff jerkin over a shirt, no red coat and no blue coat, while preserving the silhouette and morion read.

continuity_notes: Across acceptable close frames Nagoji has the required thick curled moustache and clean-shaven chin, and Keshavrao remains distinctly about nineteen with a faint moustache and no ear stud.

Nagoji's small gold stud is sometimes rendered on both ears in page 4 panel 1. The approved continuity calls for a small gold ear stud. Verify the selected revision keeps the visible stud singular or flush enough to avoid a second earring read.
Nagoji's covered left forearm and hidden brand requirement is visually respected in the current page 3 and 4 close frames. Keep it covered in replacements.
No nooses, blood, gore or invented readable lettering were found in the inspected current frames. Blank outlined reserves are present, but their count and measured fit remain a root copy-fit task.
Current scenes consistently read as an enclosed wooden ship hold except the flagged page 4 panel 5 exterior frame, which must not be selected.
